children: UMB Financial announced the redemption of all outstanding 2.75% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2031 at 100% of principal, payable Sept. 15, 2026.
All outstanding 2.75% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2031 (CUSIP 42234Q AE2) will be redeemed Sept. 15, 2026.
Redemption price equals 100% of principal plus any accrued and unpaid interest through, but excluding, Sept. 15, 2026.
Holders will receive formal notice with redemption price and instructions per the indenture; payments via DTC.
